name: Ascentrade India Private Limited
india_angle: Ekoson Technology India Pvt Ltd was established in 2019 to supply equipment and chemical products related to the manufacturing industry.
summary: Ascentrade India Private Limited, through its subsidiary Ekoson Technology India Pvt Ltd, provides electronic manufacturing equipment and products, focusing on advanced technologies such as SMT and laser systems. The company serves key industries including semiconductors, automotive, and solar energy, offering tailored solutions to enhance manufacturing productivity.
